@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The hot-air balloon c______l is a popular event in the district. Every year, thousands of tourists come to attend the celebration.
= carnival
~詞義 carnival（n.）嘉年華
~原文 The hot-air balloon carnival is a popular event in the district. Every year, thousands of tourists come to attend the celebration.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: As the manager, James's job is to o______e all the sales teams and make sure that they reach their goals.
= oversee
~詞義 oversee（v.）監督
~原文 As the manager, James's job is to oversee all the sales teams and make sure that they reach their goals.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: There is a s______e color difference between the two bags: One is slightly darker than the other.
= subtle
~詞義 subtle（adj.）細微的
~原文 There is a subtle color difference between the two bags: One is slightly darker than the other.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The city is building new h______g units for young people who can't afford to buy their own apartments.
= housing
~詞義 housing（n.）住宅(總稱)
~原文 The city is building new housing units for young people who can't afford to buy their own apartments.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Linda had so much fun at the dinner party that she decided to p______g her stay by spending the night at her friend's place.
= prolong
~詞義 prolong（v.）延長
~原文 Linda had so much fun at the dinner party that she decided to prolong her stay by spending the night at her friend's place.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There is a(n) ______ resemblance between Tom and his father, and they are often mistaken for each other.
A: abnormal
B: gross
C: striking
D: virtual
= C
~詞義 striking（adj.）驚人的
~原文 There is a(n) striking resemblance between Tom and his father, and they are often mistaken for each other.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many people are calling for ______ reform so that the lawmaking process can be more efficient.
A: legislative
B: muscular
C: subsequent
D: trivial
= A
~詞義 legislative（adj.）法律的;立法的
~原文 Many people are calling for legislative reform so that the lawmaking process can be more efficient.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Losing both her parents in a car accident caused mental ______ to Debbie, and she still hasn't recovered from it after all these years.
A: custody
B: insight
C: portfolio
D: trauma
= D
~詞義 trauma（n.）創傷
~原文 Losing both her parents in a car accident caused mental trauma to Debbie, and she still hasn't recovered from it after all these years.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: I was the last person to ______ my final exam answer sheet to the teacher. I didn't even finish the exam paper when the bell rang.
A: howl
B: inherit
C: riot
D: submit
= D
~詞義 submit（v.）提交
~原文 I was the last person to submit my final exam answer sheet to the teacher. I didn't even finish the exam paper when the bell rang.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The house has a spacious ______ where children can run around and have fun. It is more suitable than an apartment for a family.
A: backyard
B: canal
C: debut
D: peasant
= A
~詞義 backyard（n.）後院
~原文 The house has a spacious backyard where children can run around and have fun. It is more suitable than an apartment for a family.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: abruptly
B: ballot
C: myth
D: canvas
E: risky
F: virtually

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many still believe the ______ that eating after exercising is harmful, although science has disproved that claim.
= C
~詞義 myth（n.）迷思
~原文 Many still believe the myth that eating after exercising is harmful, although science has disproved that claim.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mandy insisted on meeting a stranger she had met online even though she knew it was a(n) ______ thing to do.
= E
~詞義 risky（adj.）有風險的
~原文 Mandy insisted on meeting a stranger she had met online even though she knew it was a(n) risky thing to do.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: With modern technology, it has become ______ impossible to hide your online actions completely.
= F
~詞義 virtually（adv.）幾乎就是
~原文 With modern technology, it has become virtually impossible to hide your online actions completely.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The concert stopped ______ when the fire alarm activated, and everyone left right away.
= A
~詞義 abruptly（adv.）突然地
~原文 The concert stopped abruptly when the fire alarm activated, and everyone left right away.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: When voting, we must not show others our ______ so as not to violate the principle of secrecy.
= B
~詞義 ballot（n.）選票
~原文 When voting, we must not show others our ballot so as not to violate the principle of secrecy.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: abortion
B: provisions
C: grossed
D: debris
E: utility
F: inherited

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The big earthquake shook the house, and many things dropped to the ground. Now, there is ______ all over the floor.
= D
~詞義 debris（n.）殘骸
~原文 The big earthquake shook the house, and many things dropped to the ground. Now, there is debris all over the floor.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The hikers carried enough ______ to survive two nights in the forest without outside support.
= B
~詞義 provision（n.）糧食
~原文 The hikers carried enough provisions to survive two nights in the forest without outside support.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sam ______ a fortune from his grandfather, but he does not intend to use all the money for himself.
= F
~詞義 inherit（v.）繼承
~原文 Sam inherited a fortune from his grandfather, but he does not intend to use all the money for himself.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Some people are against ______ for religious reasons, but others believe that a woman should have the right to make the decision under certain circumstances.
= A
~詞義 abortion（n.）墮胎
~原文 Some people are against abortion for religious reasons, but others believe that a woman should have the right to make the decision under certain circumstances.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The movie ______ more than 13 billion dollars worldwide, making it the most successful film of the year.
= C
~詞義 gross（v.）總收入為
~原文 The movie grossed more than 13 billion dollars worldwide, making it the most successful film of the year.
